entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Maghhhey, Sht'oxt'iht'eh, shihtsí, me'isħdaey, pagħbexnuhdet. Maghnihhey, k'ah dü'Tey, sht'iey kol, Nṙ'cay xunttigh. Hełzáz' zunttigh, Nelzaz' zunttigh.
